label: Joint-satisfiability models for the unified Dei Filius route
paraphrase: Closed controls on two explicit interpretations; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Sufficiency model, two beings: true has the nine; false is a caused intellect, composite (its esse is not its essence), in potency to understanding and moved in that respect, not INFINITE_1, a creature whose esse is received and limited; only true is LIVING_1, LORD_1, IMMENSE_1, INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1 and BLESSED_1. Every premise of the unified sufficiency route holds, as do the open leaves of the registered derivations of its nine-statements (intellect is the capacity to understand; that capacity is exercised or in potency; exercised understanding is an immanent operation; the self-operating unmoved lives; nothing is moved except as in potency; the directing bridge; directing is governing; the four reception premises; the finite-intellect bridge) and 'Whatever has its being caused by another is not INFINITE_1'. true has every Dei Filius attribute, and the old bridge 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 lives' fails (false has intellect and is not LIVING_1). (2) Root model, given excluded middle: the four roles of the full25 fixture of the spine root with its act, cause, grade, modal, part, priority, cognitive, potency and eternity dictionaries unchanged and one change, every essence is source, so every role other than source has esse distinct from essence, is composite and is not INFINITE_1. All twenty-two spine-root premises, the eleven Dei Filius premises of the unified root route and the same leaves hold, and the selected root source has every Dei Filius attribute. On the all-true act dictionary every role is pure act and universally perfect, so the recipient is also BLESSED_2 and LIVING_1; the model witnesses joint satisfiability only. (3) In the unchanged full25 fixture, whose INFINITE_1 is esse equal to essence, 'Whatever has its being caused by another is not INFINITE_1' fails: supporter is caused by source and has esse equal to essence. That is why model (2) changes the essence map.
